packageRules.description: Auto-merge minor/patch PRs when CI passes (7-day wait, stricter than the 3-day default). Lock file maintenance has no such wait for the versions it moves, so it is not automerged.
Auto-open PRs for major updates; review manually

TypeScript 7 breaks collection-reviewer-web's Next.js build (Next fails to detect TypeScript, build worker crashes with "The id argument must be of type string"). Reviewer unit tests and tsc do not run that production build, so keep major TypeScript updates disabled until Next.js/TS7 compatibility is confirmed manually
Auto-merge pin and digest updates once CI passes. Minor and patch updates keep their own 7-day wait above.

configure-aws-credentials is invoked only by the credentialed main-branch deploy job, so pull-request CI cannot show that a new pin or digest works. This rule is after the pin/digest automerge rule so it overrides that automerge. It matches depName, which the github-actions manager always sets to owner/repo.

The other actions the deploy job runs share its OIDC token and, in post steps, the AWS deploy credentials. Passing pull-request CI can't show that new action code is safe to run there, so their updates also wait for a review.
